Administration under Delhi Sultanate
The Turkish Sultan in India declared themselves Lieutenant of the
faithful ie of the Abbasid caliphate of Baghdad and included his name
in  Jutba it did not mean that the caliph became the legal ruler: The

Political, legal and military authority was vested in the Sultan. He Was

the military forces_
